coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available, so trial registries, preprint servers, regulator databases, citation graphs, patent sources, and chemistry databases cannot be searched directly.
Forward-citation and complete backward-citation traversal cannot be guaranteed through the available route; author-cluster expansion and review reference discovery provide only partial substitutes.
PubMed indexing may incompletely capture very recent online-first records, non-English literature, conference abstracts, and ancestry-specific studies outside MEDLINE coverage.
A PubMed-only plan cannot independently verify unpublished null results or fully assess publication bias.
exclusion_criteria: Records mentioning Parkinson disease or LRRK2 only incidentally without relevant genetic, enzymatic, substrate, or physiological evidence.
Studies of unrelated LRRK family members without explicit LRRK2 evidence.
Purely descriptive clinical reports lacking information relevant to genetic discovery, variant interpretation, penetrance, mechanism, or substrate-linked physiology.
Non-Parkinson conditions are excluded unless they directly clarify a transferable LRRK2 mechanism or test the generality of a Parkinson-related claim.
Reviews, editorials, or commentaries used as the sole support for a mechanistic or variant-causality conclusion.
In vitro substrate nominations lacking direct relevance to endogenous LRRK2 biology are excluded from the physiological-substrate tier and retained only as proposed-substrate context.
Duplicate publications without distinct data are consolidated under the canonical study record.
inclusion_criteria: Publication date is on or before 2024-12-31.
Study directly addresses LRRK2 or the PARK8 locus in Parkinson disease genetics, molecular mechanism, physiological substrates, or relevant cellular physiology.
Human linkage, segregation, case-control, ancestry-specific, penetrance, or genotype-phenotype studies are eligible for genetic claims.

Primary biochemical, structural, phosphoproteomic, patient-derived, cellular, and animal studies are eligible when they directly test LRRK2 catalytic function, substrate phosphorylation, or downstream physiology.

Mechanistic substrate claims require traceable experimental support such as direct phosphorylation, mapped sites, endogenous perturbation, genetic dependence, inhibitor sensitivity, or orthogonal validation.
Reviews may support terminology expansion and reference discovery, while final mechanistic claims must be traced to primary records.
Null, negative, replication, contradictory, correction, and retraction records are eligible when they constrain a major claim.
Records are deduplicated by PMID, DOI, and study identity while preserving every query-to-record occurrence.

queries.purpose: Recover anchor reports connecting the PARK8 locus and LRRK2 mutations to inherited Parkinson disease while validating core aliases.
queries.query: ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab] OR dardarin[tiab]) AND (linkage[tiab] OR cloning[tiab] OR mutation*[tiab] OR discover*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Maximize recall for familial and population genetic evidence, including causal and susceptibility variants.
queries.query: ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[tiab] OR "Parkinson's disease"[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab] OR dardarin[tiab]) AND (variant*[tiab] OR mutation*[tiab] OR genotype*[tiab] OR penetrance[tiab] OR segregation[tiab] OR association[tiab])

queries.purpose: Confirm evidence and classification for major pathogenic, risk-modifying, and protective alleles.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (G2019S[tiab] OR R1441C[tiab] OR R1441G[tiab] OR R1441H[tiab] OR Y1699C[tiab] OR I2020T[tiab] OR N1437H[tiab] OR G2385R[tiab] OR R1628P[tiab] OR R1398H[tiab]) AND ("Parkinson disease"[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab] OR pathogenic*[tiab] OR penetrance[tiab] OR risk[tiab] OR protective[tiab])

queries.purpose: Map the dual kinase-GTPase architecture, catalytic regulation, and effects of disease-associated variants.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab] OR dardarin[tiab]) AND (kinase[tiab] OR GTPase[tiab] OR ROC[tiab] OR COR[tiab] OR "GTP binding"[tiab] OR "GTP hydrolysis"[tiab] OR autophosphorylation[tiab])

queries.purpose: Test the prominent claim that G2019S enhances kinase activity and identify structural or pharmacological corroboration.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] AND G2019S[tiab]) AND ("kinase activity"[tiab] OR phosphorylation[tiab] OR structure[tiab] OR conformation[tiab] OR activation[tiab] OR inhibitor*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Discover proposed physiological substrates and the experimental routes used to nominate them.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[tiab]) AND (substrate*[tiab] OR phosphoproteom*[tiab] OR "Rab GTPase"[tiab] OR Rab8A[tiab] OR Rab10[tiab] OR Rab12[tiab] OR Rab29[tiab] OR Rab35[tiab] OR Rab3[tiab])

queries.purpose: Prioritize direct endogenous, genetic, inhibitor-sensitive, and patient-derived validation of Rab phosphorylation.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (Rab8A[tiab] OR Rab10[tiab] OR Rab12[tiab] OR Rab29[tiab] OR Rab35[tiab]) AND (endogenous[tiab] OR physiological[tiab] OR phosphorylation[tiab] OR phosphosite*[tiab] OR knockout[tiab] OR inhibitor*[tiab] OR "patient-derived"[tiab])

queries.purpose: Connect catalytic and substrate findings to cellular physiology and Parkinson-relevant phenotypes.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (Rab*[tiab] OR lysosom*[tiab] OR autophag*[tiab] OR endolysosom*[tiab] OR "vesicle trafficking"[tiab] OR mitochondri*[tiab] OR cili*[tiab] OR neuron*[tiab]) AND (mechanism*[tiab] OR function*[tiab] OR pathway*[tiab] OR phenotype*[tiab])

queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (Paisan-Ruiz[author] OR Zimprich[author] OR Steger[author] OR West[author])

queries.purpose: Retrieve human evidence limiting deterministic or population-general interpretations of LRRK2-associated disease.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND ("incomplete penetrance"[tiab] OR "variable penetrance"[tiab] OR "variable expressivity"[tiab] OR "population-specific"[tiab] OR heterogeneity[tiab] OR "risk factor"[tiab] OR phenocopy[tiab]) AND ("Parkinson disease"[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab])

queries.purpose: Seek failed replication, alternative mechanisms, model dependence, uncertain substrate generality, corrections, and retractions.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (substrate*[tiab] OR kinase[tiab] OR Rab*[tiab] OR mechanism*[tiab]) AND (negative[tiab] OR conflicting[tiab] OR inconsistent[tiab] OR replication[tiab] OR "kinase-independent"[tiab] OR compensation[tiab] OR limitation*[tiab] OR correction[pt] OR retracted publication[pt])

queries.purpose: Capture recent genetic, mechanistic, and substrate evidence through the delivery cutoff.
queries.query: (("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[tiab]) AND (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (genetic*[tiab] OR variant*[tiab] OR kinase[tiab] OR GTPase[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab] OR Rab*[tiab] OR mechanism*[tiab])) AND ("2020/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: through 2024-12-31, trace how human genetic evidence established LRRK2/PARK8 involvement in Parkinson disease, distinguish causal, risk-modifying, and protective variants, define the kinase-GTPase mechanism and physiological Rab substrates, connect these findings to cellular physiology, and identify penetrance, population, model-system, substrate-validation, and variant-to-mechanism evidence that limits causal strength or generality. Scope includes human genetics, biochemical and structural studies, patient-derived systems, cells, and animal models; English-language primary studies are prioritized, with reviews used for terminology and backward reference discovery.
stop_rules: Stop after all 12 planned PubMed query events have been executed and logged with exact query strings, execution timestamps, result counts, and the 2024-12-31 cutoff.
The sentinel wave must recover anchor evidence for PARK8 or LRRK2 genetic discovery and at least one foundational pathogenic-variant report; otherwise expand aliases before screening proceeds.

Continue until evidence is represented for genetic discovery, pathogenic variants, risk or protective modifiers, kinase-GTPase mechanism, physiological substrates, cellular consequences, and limiting evidence.
Stop expansion after two consecutive expansion passes add no new decision-relevant primary study, variant class, validated substrate, mechanistic link, or material counterexample.
Stop a claim-specific branch when additional records cannot change its calibrated conclusion or uncertainty rating.
Apply the publication cutoff after retrieval when PubMed date indexing is ambiguous and report unresolved online-first or correction-date ambiguity.
If the 12-event budget is exhausted before saturation, stop and report the affected evidence domains as coverage gaps.

Any unavailable source class or unresolved disagreement between human, biochemical, cellular, and animal evidence remains an explicit limitation rather than being resolved by further unsupported inference.
